list.title: components/content/attachments.vue
list.description:
Attachments and external links component for the ICJIA R3 Nuxt 3 application.

This component displays downloadable attachments and external links in a structured format. It supports both table and list display modes, file size formatting, and date formatting. Commonly used for displaying documents, resources, and related links on content pages.

list.title: goToSearch

list.title: icons
list.description: Material Design icons for box decoration. Provides visual indicators for different box types. Array of Material Design icon names.

list.title: module.exports.computed.boxColumns
list.description: Calculates the number of columns each box should span. Based on the total number of boxes and 12-column grid system.

list.title: module.exports.methods.click
list.description: Handles smooth scrolling to target elements. Provides navigation to specific sections with offset compensation.

list.title: module.exports.methods.getColor
list.description: Gets the primary color for box styling. Returns the secondary color from the colors array.

list.title: module.exports.props.attachmentHeading
list.description: Heading text displayed above the attachments section. Provides context for the downloadable files.

list.title: module.exports.props.attachments
list.description: Array of attachment objects containing file information. Each attachment should include properties like name, url, size, and date.

list.title: module.exports.props.boxes
list.description: Number of boxes to display in the grid. Determines the column layout and responsive behavior.

list.title: module.exports.props.data
list.description: Optional data object for table of contents content. Can be used to provide custom TOC structure instead of auto-generation.

list.title: module.exports.props.gutter
list.description: Whether to apply gutter spacing between boxes. Controls the spacing and visual separation of box elements.

list.title: module.exports.props.linkHeading
list.description: Heading text displayed above the external links section. Provides context for the external resources.

list.title: module.exports.props.links
list.description: Array of external link objects. Each link should include properties like title, url, and description.

list.title: module.exports.props.secondRow
list.description: Whether to display a second row of boxes. Enables additional content sections below the main boxes.

list.title: module.exports.props.showTableDisplay
list.description: Whether to display attachments in a table format. When false, attachments are displayed in a simpler list format.

list.title: module.exports.props.showTeaser
list.description: Whether to show teaser content in the boxes. Enables preview or summary content display.

list.title: module.exports.props.title
list.description: Title displayed in the table of contents header. Provides context for the navigation section.

list.title: module.exports.setup~altState

list.title: module.exports.setup~appConfig

list.title: module.exports.setup~appConfig
list.description: Application configuration object containing navigation menu structure. Provides access to the navigation menu items and their properties.

list.title: module.exports.setup~closeDialog
list.description: Closes the translation dialog and resets toggle state. Includes focus management for accessibility.

list.title: module.exports.setup~dirs
list.description: Array of path segments split by forward slashes. Used to build the hierarchical breadcrumb structure.

list.title: module.exports.setup~drawer
list.description: Local drawer state for the navigation drawer component. Controls the visibility of the mobile sidebar navigation.

list.title: module.exports.setup~formatDate
list.description: Formats a date string into a human-readable format. Uses the browser's locale settings for appropriate date formatting.

list.title: module.exports.setup~googleTranslate
list.description: Opens Google Translate for the specified language.

list.title: module.exports.setup~isExternalUrl
list.description: Determines if a URL is external to the application. Currently returns true for all URLs - may need refinement for actual external link detection.

list.title: module.exports.setup~navMenu
list.description: Deep copy of the navigation menu configuration. Creates an independent copy to prevent mutations of the original config. Array of navigation menu items.
